# SAP Server Access

> SAP Server Access provides SAP server access and SAP training resources for students, institutions, and companies.

## Main Pages

- [Home](http://localhost:4173/)
- [About Us](http://localhost:4173/about)
- [Contact](http://localhost:4173/contact)
- [Features](http://localhost:4173/features)
- [FAQ](http://localhost:4173/faq)

- [SAP HCM](http://localhost:4173/sap-hcm)
